name: Intercompany Consolidation
title: Intercompany Consolidation
answer: Intercompany consolidation is the process of combining the accounts of a parent company and its subsidiaries into a single set of group financial statements, after eliminating transactions and balances that exist only between entities in the group. It sits inside financial reporting and synthesis, where the group result matters more than any single legal entity. The work covers the elimination of intercompany sales, loans, dividends, and unrealised profit in inventory, plus the translation of foreign subsidiaries into the presentation currency. It also covers minority or non-controlling interests, so the group shows the share of profit and net assets it does not own.

sections.body: Intercompany consolidation is the process of combining the accounts of a parent company and its subsidiaries into a single set of group financial statements, after eliminating transactions and balances that exist only between entities in the group. It sits inside financial reporting and synthesis, where the group result matters more than any single legal entity. The work covers the elimination of intercompany sales, loans, dividends, and unrealised profit in inventory, plus the translation of foreign subsidiaries into the presentation currency. It also covers minority or non-controlling interests, so the group shows the share of profit and net assets it does not own.
sections.heading: Scope

sections.body: Consolidation runs on a group ledger or consolidation module that sits above the individual entity books, usually inside an ERP or a dedicated consolidation tool. Each subsidiary submits a reporting package in a common chart of accounts and a common calendar, and the system maps local accounts to group accounts. Intercompany matching is the load-bearing part of the infrastructure, because a sale recorded by one entity must be found and matched against the corresponding purchase in another. Data quality at the entity level determines whether the group close is a reconciliation exercise or a repair job.
sections.heading: What it runs on

sections.body: The work starts with a group reporting calendar, a submission template, and a set of consolidation rules agreed before the close. Controllers collect entity packages, check them for completeness and consistency, then run the eliminations, which are increasingly automated through matching engines that pair intercompany receivables with payables and flag breaks. Differences are investigated at the transaction level, not smoothed away, and adjustments are posted with an audit trail. Currency translation follows the group policy, with average rates for the income statement and closing rates for the balance sheet, and the resulting translation reserve is tracked separately.
sections.heading: How the work is done

sections.body: Consolidation sits under the group's financial reporting controls, so the same standards of evidence, review, and sign-off apply as to the statutory accounts. Intercompany balances and transactions must be supported by agreements and by documentation that survives audit, and transfer pricing between entities is a tax matter as much as an accounting one. Access to the consolidation system is restricted, changes to mapping and elimination rules are logged, and the group auditor tests the elimination logic and the completeness of the entity population. Where a subsidiary is newly acquired or disposed of, the consolidation perimeter and the related disclosures are reviewed before the numbers are published.
sections.heading: Rights, risk and provenance

sections.body: The direction of travel is continuous consolidation, where entity data flows into the group view as it is posted rather than in a month-end batch. That shift puts more weight on a single group chart of accounts, on clean intercompany identifiers at the point of entry, and on automated matching that resolves routine breaks without a controller. It also raises the value of the elimination trail, because a faster close is only useful if the audit evidence keeps pace. The practical constraint is not the software but the discipline of the entities feeding it.
